ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) distribution covering approximately 85% of the surface area, with localized high-intensity (white) markings providing high-contrast features across the remaining 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discrete high-contrast white annular rings (rosettes) at [x=15%, y=45%] and [x=85%, y=30%]. A large, complex geometric cluster of white parallel stripes and thick undulating bands is mapped to the lower right quadrant from x=75% to x=95%.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped notch at the central axis (x=50%) with an approximate interior vertex angle of 35-40 degrees and a vertical depth of ~12% relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with a high frequency of serrations; pixel-amplitude of peak-to-valley variations ranges from 3 to 15 pixels, with the most prominent jagged peaks located on the outer lateral margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A continuous concave upward curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, which exhibit a sharp upward inflection.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters; three distinct rings on the mid-left lobe and a cluster of two overlapping rings on the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of numerous fine, low-contrast, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) scattered across the dark central regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant rake mark scarring on the right lobe, characterized by five vertical parallel white stripes and several thick horizontal bands. The distal tips of both lobes show extreme rugosity and white pixel clusters indicative of barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique 'comb-like' or 'zebra-stripe' rake mark configuration in the lower right quadrant, isolated from other pigmentation.
